nodes.label: FocusForge Application

nodes.rationale: Ensure core features work without network and reduce latency by writing locally first.

nodes.label: Timestamp-Anchored Timing
nodes.rationale: Ensure ±1s accuracy by polling wall-clock anchor, surviving backgrounding/lock.

nodes.label: Gamified Engagement
nodes.rationale: Non-preachy wellness through positive reinforcement (XP, confetti).

nodes.label: 60FPS Performance
nodes.rationale: Critical for user retention; offload heavy tasks to worklets.

nodes.label: Type-Safe Architecture
nodes.rationale: Ensure structural integrity and catch regressions via strict TypeScript.

nodes.label: Three-Layer AI Architecture
nodes.rationale: Uses Claude (Haiku & Sonnet) for non-judgmental, curiosity-driven coaching.

nodes.label: Timestamp-Anchored Approach
nodes.rationale: Timer must survive backgrounding and relocks.
